title.en: How Can I Help Thinking of Her

edition.en: Text from Chinese Wikisource, transcribed from Raising the Whip (揚鞭集, 1926); written in London on 4 September 1920.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，录自《扬鞭集》（1926）；1920 年 9 月 4 日作于伦敦。

basis.en: Written in 1920 and published in book form in 1926; the author died in 1934. Public domain by age: the author died before 1956 and the text was published before 1931.
basis.zh: 1920 年作，1926 年收入诗集出版，作者卒于 1934 年。作者卒于 1956 年前、作品发表于 1931 年前，按年限属公有领域。

note.en: Written in London in 1920 and later set to music by the linguist Zhao Yuanren, this short song uses 她 for 'her', the written pronoun for women that Liu Bannong had proposed, and it helped carry the character into everyday use. It is here because a single new character, offered freely, became everyone's. Notice how each stanza passes through a different light, from light clouds and moonlight to fallen petals and the last afterglow.
note.zh: 1920 年作于伦敦，后来由语言学家赵元任谱成歌曲。诗中用“她”字指女性，这正是刘半农提倡的新代词，这首诗帮它进入了日常书写。收在这里，是因为一个无偿提出的新字，最后成了所有人的字。留意每一节经过不同的光景，从微云、月光，到落花，再到西天的残霞。

excerpt.orig: 月光戀愛着海洋，海洋戀愛着月光。
excerpt.en: The moonlight is in love with the sea, the sea is in love with the moonlight.
excerpt.zh: 月光恋爱着海洋，海洋恋爱着月光。
